tagline: Property and casualty insurance provider with proprietary technology platform for underwriting and claims optimization

risks.title: Catastrophic Events
risks.summary: Natural catastrophes represent the major risk to the business model
risks.score_rationale: Catastrophic events such as hurricanes could have a significant and adverse impact on business operations, operating results, and financial condition. The nature of homeowners insurance in Florida inherently exposes the company to these risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Changes
risks.summary: Regulatory changes can affect operations and profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulation in Florida and other states. Insurance regulators must approve policy forms and rates, and monitor compliance with financial and regulatory requirements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition in the insurance sector remains a structural challenge
risks.score_rationale: HCI operates in a competitive property and casualty insurance market. Competition may affect market share and company revenues. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology Dependency
risks.summary: Reliance on Exzeo's technology platform constitutes an operational risk
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily relies on Exzeo's proprietary technology platform to identify profitable opportunities and optimize operations. Technological failures could impact performance. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reinsurance Availability and Pricing
risks.summary: Volatility in reinsurance markets affects costs and profitability
risks.score_rationale: HCI mitigates catastrophic risks by purchasing reinsurance. Changes in reinsurance availability or pricing could increase operating costs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reserve Adequacy
risks.summary: Inadequate reserves could severely impact profitability
risks.score_rationale: Loss reserves may be insufficient if actual claims exceed estimates, which would reduce net income and shareholders' equity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.summary: Litigation and disputes may have material financial impacts
risks.score_rationale: The company may be involved in litigation related to claims or operations, with potential impacts on results and financial condition. (default score, to be refined)
